# dsh-mp-automator

[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-51%2F51-brightgreen)](https://github.com/VincentJiang06/dsh-wechatmpdev/blob/main/docs/evidence/green-run.txt)

Eight `mp_*` tools that let a dsh agent drive a real Mini Program in WeChat
DevTools — inspect pages, act on elements, capture screenshots, read the
console — with the correctness discipline built **into the tools** ins
